title: Comparing and Ordering Numbers up to 20
seo_title: Grade 1 Comparing Numbers to 20 Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 1)
standard_text: Compare two numbers up to 20; order numbers up to 20 from smallest to largest, and vice versa.
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 worksheets on comparing and ordering numbers to 20 for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: more and fewer, the signs > and <, and putting numbers in order. 100 questions with pictures and answers.
key_big: Numbers get bigger to the right.
key_sub: The sign opens to the bigger number.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • On a number line, numbers get bigger to the right.
  • A teen number is more than any number from 0 to 9: 12 > 9.
  • The sign opens to the bigger number: 15 > 8, 8 < 15.
  • To order, find the smallest first, then the next, and so on.

Examples

Example

Order 14, 6, 19

smallest: 6

then 14

then 19

Answer: 6, 14, 19

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
12 < 912 is 1 ten and 2: it is more than 9.
Sign the wrong wayThe open side faces the bigger number.
Missing a numberCheck that every number is in the list.
